page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.3xlarge is a dedicated KVM-based server instance featuring an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz with 6 physical cores and 12 virtual threads. It is equipped with 48 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, and operates with a 4 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The defining hardware specification of this instance is its bundled local HDD storage capacity of 35,433 GB (35.4 TB). It does not include dedicated GPU hardware accelerators.

Benchmark results highlight a notable trade-off between single-threaded and multi-threaded performance. Single-core processing ranks low across tests, with a Geekbench single-core score of 911.0 and a single-core stress-ng metric of 1102.49. However, multi-threaded throughput achieves average benchmark results, reaching a multi-core Geekbench score of 4584.0, a PassMark CPU score of 10074.03, and 8.27 million Redis SET operations per second. Large block memory read bandwidth sits at 54.9 GB/sec.

The presence of 35.4 TB of local HDD storage paired with moderate multi-core CPU performance offers qualitative cost efficiency for storage-bound environments. The server is well-suited for high-capacity local data logging, archive management, warm storage nodes, batch processing, and bulk database operations where high storage density is prioritized over fast single-core CPU speed.
